items.title: Obtain Meta credentials
items.detail: Get Facebook Page approval + Meta Developer app, then populate secrets/mq.env with FB_PAGE_ID, FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (Maia page) and QI_PAGE_ID, QI_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN (QI page). This is the single hard blocker for any real publishing.

items.title: First end-to-end dry run
items.detail: Run Kaze to fetch a real digest, Fumi to generate a draft, and the publisher in --dry-run mode — proving the pipeline works before a single live post. Nothing in the pipeline has executed yet.

items.title: Configure the LLM keys
items.detail: Set CF_ACCOUNT_ID + CF_AI_TOKEN (Cloudflare Workers AI) and confirm a local Ollama with qwen3:8b for fallback, so Fumi can actually generate text.

items.title: Register as a persistent QI service
items.detail: Wrap main.py as an NSSM service named QI_MQ* (AppDirectory C:\MQ), set Description, and register it in C:\QIH\ecosystem\QI_Service_Registry.md so the API/UI stay up and the Hive dashboard can monitor MQ live.

items.title: Build gate/ — draft to approve to publish
items.detail: Implement the approval queue so nothing reaches a surface without the Governor approving it (Bible Law 0 / D3). Today Fumi would auto-publish, which the persona model forbids. Default mode must be draft-and-approve.

items.title: Approval UI
items.detail: A review surface (likely a Gradio tab) where pending drafts are approved, edited, or rejected before they go out. Listed as a future extension in FUMI.md.

categories.name: Become the real Maia (the Hybrid migration)

items.title: Split Fumi: writing half to maia/voice
items.detail: Move post composition (PERSONA_MAIA/PERSONA_QI + generate_draft) out of agents/fumi into maia/voice — because the composer IS Maia, not plumbing (D11). Done once, alongside the gate and memory, since the pipeline is being redesigned for 4 surfaces.

items.title: Build maia/memory — her diary
items.detail: Persistent persona memory of places 'been', posts made, opinions formed, threads in progress. Required for consistency and for the maturation arc (D8). Without it she is amnesiac and cannot mature.

items.title: Wire all four surfaces
items.detail: Today only the Maia page and QI page are coded. Add the weekly AI+markets analyst register (Morningstar-style, named sources, never financial advice) and the unfiltered quiddam.com diary feed (D6/D7).

items.title: Settle the open dials
items.detail: Resolve the 6 open decisions in DECISIONS.md — chiefly Dial #1 (how openly AI she is), which unblocks her biography, plus posting intervals, which QI projects she may discuss, markets depth, biographical anchors, and the platform vehicle (profile vs Page).

items.title: Lock the Identity Kit
items.detail: Populate identity/manifest.json: canonical face reference images + a fixed seed/embedding, one canonical TTS voice, and a visual style (palette/fonts/aesthetic). Lock this BEFORE generating any media or every render is a different Maia.

items.title: Visible Maia (maia/face)
items.detail: Consistent AI-generated photos and realistic video of Maia, all the same person — depends on the locked likeness.

items.title: Spoken Maia (maia/speech)
items.detail: TTS in one canonical voice so Maia can speak — depends on the locked voice.

items.title: Instagram posting + DM auto-reply
items.detail: Publish images + captions via the IG Content Publishing API and auto-reply to DMs on the linked Business account (FUMI.md future extensions).

items.title: WhatsApp Business auto-reply
items.detail: Free-tier automated replies via the WhatsApp Cloud API under the Maia Quiddam identity.

items.title: Facebook Messenger auto-reply
items.detail: Inbound -> compose in voice -> gate -> reply, via maia/conversation.

items.title: Post analytics + smarter sourcing
items.detail: Track reach/engagement via Graph API insights; select post images from an image API (e.g. Unsplash) by topic. Both listed as future extensions in FUMI.md.
